data.one_liner: Launches an installed Android app by its package ID, falling back to Google Play if missing.
data.what_it_does: The plugin checks if a given Android application ID is installed on the device and opens it. If the app is not found, it redirects the user to the app's Google Play Store page. iOS support is not yet implemented.
use_when: You need to open another app from your Flutter app on Android
You want a simple fallback to Google Play when the target app is absent
avoid_when: You need advanced deep‑link handling or argument passing
strengths: Handles missing apps by opening Play Store automatically
weaknesses: No support for passing arguments or iOS
